name: 2026 Fall — Catch, Footwork & Speed
goal: Fix the catch (elbows, knees, feet) and first-pull knee position, build speed above the knee and lockout, then test with a Week 6 max-out and a Week 12 Olympic Total

phases.title: MESOCYCLE 1 — CATCH, FOOTWORK & FIRST-PULL POSITION
phases.subtitle: Weeks 1–6 · 9/14–10/24 · Build through Week 5, then Week 6 Saturday is a max-out test on both lifts (Week 6 Monday is light prep)

intent.title: Week 1 · 9/14–9/19
intent.text: Positions are rebuilt away from the floor first. No-feet snatch/clean forces a disciplined, narrow catch by removing foot movement entirely; muscle snatch/clean removes the leg re-bend that lets the knees-forward habit sneak in; paused deadlifts drill the knee-back reversal directly. No full lift from the floor yet.

exercises.name: Snatch Deadlift (pause below knee)
exercises.note: Pause below the knee with shins pulled to vertical and knees pushed out, then consciously reverse the knees back before continuing — this is the knees-forward fix

exercises.name: No-Feet Snatch
exercises.note: Feet stay in the catch stance the whole rep — no jump, no reset — this is the landing-width fix

exercises.name: Snatch Balance
exercises.note: Land soft, think push under the bar, not dropping

exercises.name: Muscle Snatch
exercises.note: No leg re-bend — forces correct knee/hip sequencing instead of a floor pull

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Knees out through the whole rep

exercises.name: Front Squat (pause)
exercises.note: 2s pause at bottom — elbows up and forward

exercises.note: Front heel down first, back foot on the ball — light and crisp

intent.title: Week 6 · 10/19–10/24 · Test Week
intent.text: Monday is deliberately light — technique touches only, no strength stimulus — so you walk into Saturday fresh. Saturday is a Meso 1 max test on both lifts: a dress rehearsal for the Week 12 total.

exercises.note: Footwork reminder ahead of tomorrow's test

exercises.name: Snatch (light openers)
exercises.note: Prime the pattern, don't chase fatigue

exercises.name: Tall Clean (strict elbow finish)
exercises.note: Elbow reminder for tomorrow's clean

intent.title: Week 7 · 10/26–10/31 · Back-Off Week
intent.text: A slight back-off after the Week 6 max test. Same speed/lockout priorities as the rest of Meso 2, but load drops back so the body recovers before building again.

exercises.name: Heaving Snatch Balance
exercises.note: Push the floor away, shrug into the bar — lighter than last week's test, this is recovery-minded

exercises.name: Muscle Snatch
exercises.note: Maintenance for knee/hip sequencing

exercises.name: Snatch Pull (above knee, speed)
exercises.note: Jump, don't muscle — light enough to move fast the week after a max effort

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Light — recovery, not a strength stimulus this week

exercises.name: Muscle Clean
exercises.note: Elbows up and around — whip, not muscle up

exercises.name: Clean Pull (above knee, speed)
exercises.note: Jump, don't muscle — light enough to move fast

exercises.name: Split Jerk
exercises.note: Maintenance — front heel down first

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Light — recovery week
